title: Warm Queso Tinga
description: A comforting Mexican dish featuring warm, melted cheese and tender tinga.

ingredients.name: Tinga (Shredded Chicken in Chipotle Tomato Sauce)

instructions: Preheat a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the tinga to the saucepan and warm it through.
Place a tortilla in the saucepan and sprinkle with cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook for 30-45 seconds.
Flip the tortilla and cook for another 30-45 seconds.
Serve warm with sour cream and cilantro.
